text: Implemented first JVM result export adapter. Added image-level lightweight NIfTI writeVec/writeVol with roundtrip tests; added fit JVM ResultManifestWriter with typed BidsDirectory/Hdf5/Gds targets, BIDS-style NIfTI parameter/contrast map bundles, coefficient covariance TSV, and JSON sidecar. HDF5/GDS currently return explicit unsupported-format errors. Evidence: imageJVM/test passed 159; fitJVM/test passed 120; modelJVM/test passed 16; modelJS/test passed 16; fitJS/test passed 115; scoped diff/trailing whitespace clean. Remaining: real HDF5/GDS stores and richer BIDS entity modeling; compressed reduced-rank/latent backend still pending.
